title: post api auth registro create user account
description: Verify that a new user can register with valid nombre, email, and password, receiving a 201 status with a token and user object without password.

title: post api auth login authenticate user
description: Verify that a user can log in with valid email and password, receiving a 200 status with a token and user object.

title: get api auth perfil get authenticated user profile
description: Verify that an authenticated user can retrieve their profile using a valid x-token header, receiving a 200 status with the user profile.

title: put api auth perfil update authenticated user profile
description: Verify that an authenticated user can update their nombre and/or email with valid data and a valid x-token header, receiving a 200 status with the updated user.

title: put api auth password change user password
description: Verify that an authenticated user can change their password by providing the correct current password and a valid new password, receiving a 200 status with a confirmation message.

title: get api usuarios list users with admin role
description: Verify that an admin user can list active users with optional search, role filter, pagination, and receive a 200 status with total, pagination data, and ordered user list.

title: get api usuarios id get user details by id
description: Verify that an admin user can retrieve details of an active user by valid id, receiving a 200 status with the user details.

title: post api usuarios create new user by admin
description: Verify that an admin user can create a new user with valid data, receiving a 201 status with the created user and ensuring the password is hashed.

title: put api usuarios id update user details by admin
description: Verify that an admin user can update user details partially by id, cannot change their own role, and receives a 200 status with the updated user.

title: delete api usuarios id logical delete user by admin
description: Verify that an admin user can logically delete a user by id, cannot delete their own account, and receives a 200 status with a confirmation message and the deactivated user.
